wiki.title: Paul Jacobs (politician)
wiki.extract: Paul Jacobs is a Republican member of the Illinois Senate from the 59th district. Jacobs took office June 17, 2026. He was appointed to fill the vacancy created by the resignation of Dale Fowler. Prior to his appointment to the Illinois Senate, he served in the Illinois House of Representatives from January 11, 2021 to June 17, 2026.
